name: FlagOctree Construction
definition: A GPU-based algorithm for constructing a flag octree from a list of fragment positions. It uses atomic operations to mark nodes in a shared pool as occupied, building the tree structure implicitly via pointers stored in a single `childPtr` field.
summary: FlagOctree Construction is a GPU algorithm building sparse voxel octrees via atomic operations and a unique bit-packing strategy for flags and pointers within a single childPtr field.
